request.style: English, solo female contralto with gentle choir, harp, piano, strings, warm and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They will sing of the ways of the LORD
For the glory of the LORD is great
He is exalted yet he sees the lowly
The proud he knows from afar

[Chorus]
The LORD will fulfill his purpose for me
Your steadfast love endures forever
Do not abandon the work of your hands
Your right hand saves me

[Verse]
Though I walk in the midst of trouble
You keep me alive and hold me
You stretch out your hand against the wrath
Of my enemies you save me

[Chorus]
The LORD will fulfill his purpose for me
Your steadfast love endures forever
Do not abandon the work of your hands
Your right hand saves me

[Bridge]
Steadfast love and truth are joined
Your promise does not fail
In the midst of my distress
You stand beside me still

[Outro]
The LORD will fulfill his purpose for me
Do not abandon the work of your hands
